This 1927 film is a masterpiece of Ukrainian cinema, with renewed relevance today. As part of this film tour, PCO will raise funds to provide humanitarian assistance to Ukraine. The group will donate a large percentage of the proceeds to Ukrainian humanitarian relief agencies. Dziga Vertov (best known as director of Man with a Movie Camera 1929) was born and raised in Ukraine. He retained an allegiance to this Soviet republic throughout his life, and did extensive filming there - releasing several films on the subject. The Eleventh Year was released in 1927 and was his last film before Man with a Movie Camera. The film traces the Ukraine's progress 10 years after the Russian Revolution.
